senses.gloss: experience; knowledge or skill gained through direct encounter with things
senses.note: From erfahren (to learn, to experience), from Old High German irfaran (to travel through, reach, find out): prefix er- + fahren (to travel). Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0.

senses.gloss: (philosophy) the totality of perceptions and cognitions a subject acquires, often contrasted with Erlebnis (lived, momentary experience)
senses.note: Sense prominent in German philosophical usage (Kant, Dilthey, Benjamin, Adorno). Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0.
